t: A round learning board with lights, sensors, a speaker, and Bluetooth.
steps: Buy the board from Adafruit for about 25 US dollars.
Get a micro USB cable that carries data.
Download the CircuitPython file for this board from the CircuitPython website.
Press the reset button to open the board drive. Drag the file onto it.
Install the free Mu editor on your computer.
Open the code file on the board and paste in a light example from the Adafruit guide.
Try the guide on coding the board wirelessly over Bluetooth next.
meta: Open Board. From $24.95. A few stores.
